evidence_spans: Figures 7C and D display the current-brightness and external quantum efficiency (EQE) curves, respectively. The brightness and EQE of the transferred chips show a maximum decrease of≈35%, but maintain the same trends and order of magnitude as those of the reference chips.

This reduction remains within a reasonable range compared with previously reported results, indicating that the D-DLAT process exerts an acceptable impact on the overall performance of the micro-LEDs (48, 49).

extra_quotes: A pulsed laser system (355 nm wavelength, 1 ns pulse width) generates individual laser pulses with energies ranging from 1µJ to 10µJ.

A coaxial microscope system facilitatesin-situobservation of the laser ablation and the resulting transfer displacement at an resolution of 0.97µm, thereby aiding in the evaluation of transfer precision and the optimization of process parameters.
Furthermore, a cross-correlation image processing method is employed to precisely quantify the placement mismatch of the 35×20×5µm chips, as detailed in Note S1 and Figure S5.
